card.name: Dash or gap joining clauses and numbers
card.fires_on: A hyphen-like dash after a clause in advice text, or an invisible spacing mark between numbers, such as after 10 before a superscript 9 in lab values.

modes.label: Dash after a clause
modes.description: A dash right after a sentence-like phrase in counseling answers, ahead of a trailing phrase.
modes.example: Being stuck in marital gridlock is very hard<< ->> especially around the holidays.

modes.label: Gap inside numeric values
modes.description: A hidden spacing mark between a number and the next number or exponent in lab thresholds and tables.

card.plain: It fires on odd dash or spacing marks that separate a phrase from what follows, such as in blood count values like 10 9 /L.
